issues: The original servant dishonesty and theft allegations are unsupported 1647 social stereotypes, NOT evidence of worker crime, loyalty, morality or occupational suitability.
Servant and small-cattle predictions use similar sixth-house indicators but are different social and economic outcomes; they cannot be pooled as separate successes.
Strong or benefic majority is a source qualifier without a calibrated number-of-servants threshold or independent household employment observations.
Malefic essential dignity plus favorable aspect to Ascendant ruler is an explicit positive exception to the stereotype of intrinsically malefic planets.
The sixth lord in tenth is alleged to promote servants, a different outcome from number or financial profit.
The original applied-to glyph after Mercury's favorable tenth/first/sixth/twelfth house placement is not sufficiently verified to name the planet.
Mercury retrograde OR combust and applying to malefics in fixed signs is a compound branch; not a valid character inference about human workers.
The last branch groups Saturn peregrine, South Node or Mars in airy/fiery signs in sixth as alleged source of bad servants or zero profit.
Period assumptions concerning servants, masters and cattle trade are not modern employment ethics, animal health or financial advice.
No chart birth-time verification, workers, theft adjudications, payroll records, animal profit data, cohort, or negative cases are provided.
The word 'The' at original PDF620 page bottom belongs to following unnumbered seventh-house intro whose separate heading starts PDF621.
No complete diplomatic transcription or independent historical paleography is claimed; source JPEGs and qualified anchors are retained.
